They are explaining how things got to a point that we already know about.   The Sequels are set 30 years AFTER the final film of the original trilogy.  We know nothing about that time period, just as we knew nothing when the Original Trilogy was released.  It is absolutely NOT the job of the sequel films to explain what happened in the 30 years prior to them starting! These films are moving forward into unknown territory, not simply giving us backstory like the prequels (which were rubbish!) so getting bogged down in explaining the past simply isn't an option.
